_doc: The procedural score (docs/10 §10.5, R14/B11; canon: the rain is the score). No recorded music: js/audio/score.js builds it on the sfx engine's own AudioContext and plays it through the `music` bus (the rain beds go on the `ambience` bus). `rain`: the two catalog beds and how their gains follow rain intensity 0..1 (light fades in first, heavy takes over from `heavyFrom`). `drone`: shared drone knobs (gain, detune in cents between the two oscillators of a voice, attack/release seconds, a slow filter LFO). `acts`: per act, the key, the drone notes, `voicesPerLamp` (one note ADDED to the drone for each Great Lamp relit so far, in order — the relight sweep), the low-pass filter (Hz; darker acts sit lower), the oscillator wave, and `motifShift` (semitones to transpose the Guild motif into the act's key). `motif`: the 6-note Guild bell motif (lamp-posts, title cards, relights) — notes, tempo (beats per minute, one note per beat), timbre bell partials and decay. `boss.pulse`: one bpm per phase (1..4), a low drum (pitch sweep in Hz, decay seconds). `rainStops`: fade-out seconds when the Rain stops (cs_rain_stops) and whether the score goes fully silent. Note names are scientific pitch (A4 = 440 Hz).
